meta.name: CCNL Comparto Istruzione e Ricerca 2022-2024 e 2025-2027 (trattamento economico) - ARAN

sources.title: CCNL 2025-2027 sui principali aspetti del trattamento economico, signed definitively on 1 July 2026 by ARAN and every union of the comparto. Tabella A2 (pp. 18-19): tabellare from 1.1.2025, 1.1.2026, 1.1.2027.
CCNL 2022-2024 (FLC CGIL did not sign). Tabella A2 (pp. 50-51): tabellare from 1.1.2024.
CCNL 2019-2021. Tabelle C1 and E1.5 (pp. 246, 256): tabellare from 1.2.2023.
CCNL Scuola 2006-2009, still in force for ferie (art. 13), malattia (art. 17) and tredicesima (art. 80).

source_document.title: CCNL Comparto Scuola 2006-2009, 29 novembre 2007

location.section: Art. 80 c. 1 (tredicesima mensilità)
location.quote: spetta una tredicesima mensilità corrisposta nel mese di dicembre di ogni anno.

provenance.note: Kept in force by the CCNL Istruzione e Ricerca 2022-2024 of 23 December 2025, art. 1 c. 13 ('continuano a trovare applicazione [...] i CCNL dei precedenti comparti'). Copy of the ARAN text hosted by the USR Friuli Venezia Giulia. Scuola section only.

location.section: Scheda 'I destinatari e i contributi', Dipendenti pubblici
location.quote: DIPENDENTI PUBBLICI (D.Lgs. 124/1993): Assunti dopo il 31-dic-2000 ovvero a tempo determinato: Quota TFR 100%, Lavoratore 1%, Datore di lavoro 1% [...] (1) Le quote di TFR dei dipendenti pubblici prima della cessazione del servizio non sono versate al Fondo ma sono accantonate figurativamente presso l'INPS Gestione ex INPDAP [...] (4) La contribuzione destinata al Fondo dalle Amministrazioni e dai lavoratori, è pari all'1% dei seguenti elementi retributivi: retribuzione tabellare, indennità integrativa speciale, tredicesima mensilità e retribuzione professionale (5) Misura minima per avere diritto al contributo del datore di lavoro.

provenance.transformation: 1% employer and at least 1% worker of the retribuzione tabellare (with the indennita integrativa speciale, conglobated in the tabellare of this file), the tredicesima and the retribuzione professionale: the TFR base of the engine, which holds the pay this file models. The TFR conferred and the 1.2% of an optant are accrued notionally by INPS, not paid to the fund.

notes.text: SALARY TABLES: monthly tabellare = annual tabellare of the fascia 0-8 over 12 (the tables are 'per 12 mensilità cui aggiungere la 13^ mensilità'). 1.2.2023-31.12.2023: CCNL 2019-2021 Tabelle C1 and E1.5; 2024: CCNL 2022-2024 Tabella A2; 2025, 2026, 2027: CCNL 2025-2027 Tabella A2.
CNEL S305 da kitech.it per comparto Istruzione e Ricerca personale docente. Confermato coerente con S325 (area dirigenza IR).
Platea ~1,2M: ~800k docenti (infanzia, primaria, secondaria I e II), ~230k ATA scuola, ~130k personale università e ricerca, ~80k AFAM (quifinanza.it).
Indennità di funzione (IF) docenti: da ~200€ a ~313€/mese a seconda dell'ordine (da CCNL 23/12/2025). Non modellata come fixed_allowance per eterogeneità tra ordini (SIMPLIFICATION).

Layer 2 implemented. Part-time: engine scales by part_time_pct. Fixed-term: PA is excluded from NASpI addizionale (lavoratori delle pubbliche amministrazioni in statutory exclusion list per INPS guidance); fixed_term_additional_rate=0.000 in tax file. Apprenticeship: no ARAN CCNL defines percentage or under-classification tracks; narrow high-qualification form under D.Lgs. 81/2015 Art. 47 exists for research profiles but is not operationalized in any examined CCNL.
Personale università, ricerca e AFAM: non modellato separatamente (trattamento retributivo distinto con sezioni specifiche nel CCNL). SIMPLIFICATION: unico JSON copre principalmente la scuola.
CNEL S305 confermato per comparto, include tutte le sezioni (scuola, università, ricerca, AFAM).
Hourly divisor 156 = 36h/settimana × 52/12. I docenti hanno orario cattedra (18h/settimana insegnamento), non direttamente comparabile. Il divisore si applica per l'hourly_rate indicativo.

PENSION FUND. Fondo Scuola Espero (1% + 1%); enrolment is a fact, the silenzio-assenso of the hires from 2019 is not inferred, nor the three months a fixed term needs to enrol. The TFR conferred stays a notional INPS accrual.

ASSICURAZIONE SOCIALE VITA. The employers of this CCNL are Amministrazioni dello Stato (the State schools; the forze di polizia), which INPS circ. 104/2014 leaves out of the Assicurazione Sociale Vita (ex ENPDEP): meta.public_life_insurance is false.

LEVELS. The Tabelle A1 and A2 of the CCNL 2022-2024 (from 1.1.2024) list 'Docente scuola dell'infanzia ed elementare' and 'Docente diplomato istituti sec. II grado' as two rows with the same amounts (22,420.48 a year in the first band): two levels with the same minimum, DOCENTE_INFANZIA_PRIMARIA and DOCENTE_DIPLOMATO_SECONDARIA, since only the first owes the ENAM.

The ENAM of a permanent teacher of the scuola dell'infanzia and primaria (L. 93/1957 art. 3: 1% of 80% of the stipendio) is computed on the whole minimum of the level; the stipendio it counts leaves out the IIS conglobata the retribuzione tabellare holds, which the bundle does not give apart: the contribution is overstated.

limitation.remediation: Source the IIS conglobata of the profile, leave it out of the ENAM base, then remove this note.

notes.text: The ore aggiuntive of the docenti are paid at fixed hourly amounts by activity (CCNL 2019-2021 Tabella E1.6: corsi di recupero 55,00, insegnamento 38,50, non di insegnamento 19,25), not by time of day: no overtime band is modelled for the docenti levels, so their overtime event needs the amount as hourly_rate with multiplier 1. The ATA areas are paid by the bands of Tabella E1.7.

limitation.remediation: Pass the amount of Tabella E1.6 of the activity as hourly_rate with multiplier 1.

notes.text: FASCE STIPENDIALI: the six fasce of anzianità di servizio (0-8, 9-14, 15-20, 21-27, 28-34, da 35) are paid as five seniority steps after 9, 15, 21, 28 and 35 years, each the difference between the monthly tabellari of two fasce (CCNL 2019-2021 Tabelle C1 and E1.5, 2022-2024 and 2025-2027 Tabella A2). The seniority is the anzianità di servizio recognised for the fasce (ricostruzione di carriera), which the caller states; the engine does not reconstruct it. The scuola media and the laureato di II grado have the same first fascia and differ above it: two levels, DOCENTE_SECONDARIA and DOCENTE_LAUREATO_SECONDARIA_II.

FROM 1.1.2022 TO 31.1.2023: the tabellare dal 1.1.2021 of Tabella C1 of the CCNL 2019-2021 (column 1) and, apart, the elemento perequativo by fascia (column 2, 12 instalments assumed), conglobated in the tabellare from 1.2.2023.

The CCNL counts the three years in any public administration ('a qualsiasi titolo prestato' / 'presso una qualsiasi pubblica amministrazione'); the tiers read the seniority with this employer, so a worker with earlier public service gets 26 (30) days when the text gives 28 (32): state the seniority with the earlier public service included.

location.section: Art. 17 cc. 1, 8 (assenze per malattia)
location.quote: b) 90% della retribuzione di cui alla lett. a) per i successivi 3 mesi di assenza;

provenance.note: Job kept 18 months within the three years before the day (the CCNL sums 'le assenze per malattia verificatesi nel triennio precedente' the last episode): 540 days of 30-day months over a window of 3 years; 9 months (270 days) in full, 3 (days 271-360) at 90%, 6 (days 361-540) at 50%. The window ends on the sick day, not on the start of the last episode. The cut of the accessory pay of the first 10 days (D.L. 112/2008 art. 71 c. 1) is not modelled.

reviews.scope: Whole file. The values checked were not recorded.
findings: The review recorded no list of the documents it read.

reviews.scope: Salary tables of the seven scuola profiles, leave, sickness, seniority, overtime and the daily quota, against the signed ARAN texts of 2007, 2024, 2025 and 2026.
findings: Every monthly tabellare was the annual amount over 13; the tables are per 12 mensilità plus the tredicesima: the values were about 7.7% low (e.g. Docente infanzia 2024: 1,724.65 -> 1,868.37).
The pre-2024 periods were back-calculated with the increments times 13 and started on 2022-01-01; they are now the tables of the CCNL 2019-2021, in force from 1 February 2023.
The CCNL 2025-2027 on the economic treatment, signed definitively on 1 July 2026, was missing: periods from 1.1.2025, 1.1.2026 and 1.1.2027 added.
Signatories: FLC CGIL did not sign the CCNL 2022-2024 (it signed the 2025-2027); ANIEF signed both and was missing.
Ferie: 32 days, 30 for the first 3 years (CCNL 2007 art. 13), not 28.
Sickness: comporto of 18 months with 9 months at 100%, 3 at 90% and 6 at 50% (art. 17), not 270 days at 100%.
Overtime: the scuola pays fixed hourly amounts, not percentages: the 15/30/30/50% bands had no basis and are removed.
Daily quota: no scuola text fixes it; by_26 is now assumed.

reviews.scope: Overtime of the scuola ATA staff: Tabella E1.7 of the CCNL 2019-2021 and the overtime articles of the CCNL 2022-2024 and 2025-2027.
findings: The ATA 'prestazioni aggiuntive' are paid at fixed hourly amounts by area from 1 January 2024 (Tabella E1.7): nine bands in EUR per hour by area and time of day, now paid by the engine.
The CCNL 2022-2024 (art. 23) and 2025-2027 (art. 11) update only the università overtime (Tabella B4): the scuola amounts stay those of 2024.
The docenti ore aggiuntive (Tabella E1.6) are by activity, not by time of day: left to the caller (limitation fixed_hourly_overtime, docenti levels).

reviews.scope: Fasce stipendiali of the scuola staff, 2023-2027.
findings: Every worker was paid the first fascia (0-8 years): the five higher fasce are now seniority steps, read on the tables of the three CCNL.
DOCENTE_SECONDARIA joined the scuola media and the laureato di II grado, equal in the first fascia only: split into DOCENTE_SECONDARIA (scuola media) and DOCENTE_LAUREATO_SECONDARIA_II.
The file started on 1.2.2023 (limitation before_february_2023): the tabellare dal 1.1.2021 and the elemento perequativo by fascia of Tabella C1 now cover 2022 and January 2023.

reviews.scope: The number of instalments of the elemento perequativo of the CCNL 19/04/2018 the file pays until its conglobamento.
findings: The 35 elemento perequativo records of the Scuola levels move from assumed to derived: INPS msg. 3224/2018 reads the element as paid 'con cadenza mensile', Tabella D2 of the CCNL 19/04/2018 gives 10 monthly instalments in 2018, and Tabella C1 of the CCNL 6/12/2022 (p. 244) prints the yearly amount as twelve monthly ones (308,04 = 12 x 25,67). No text puts it in the tredicesima. Art. 37 of the Scuola section was not read, so the records stay derived.
The absence rule stays assumed: no text of the comparto fixes the daily quota of an unpaid absence of the scuola staff.
